findings.issue: The headline "**Full characteristic group makes every ideal-of-definition value cofinal.**" omits the essential hypothesis `h1 : ∀ a ∈ P.idealOfDefinition, v a < 1`, and the body never mentions it. As stated the claim is false: for `v ≡ 1` the characteristic group is full but no `v x ^ n < 1`, so cofinality fails. The sibling lemma at TopologicallyNilpotent.lean:136 does name its side hypothesis ("given that the open unit ball ... is a neighbourhood of `0`"), so the convention exists.
